programs.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner
programs.desc: Does a massive treasure hide on Oak Island? For 200 years, hunters have sought riches that have eluded all and claimed six lives. Is this North Atlantic cache real, or is it protected by a legendary, deadly curse?

programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programs.desc: For 107 years, a dust-covered box has remained hidden in a British manor house. This box contains the personal notes of Lord Mersey, the respected British jurist and politician charged with investigating the sinking of Titanic in 1912.

programs.title: Lost Gold Of World War Ii
programs.desc: As the team finally gets to the bottom of Breach 6, startling new evidence suggests they might be too late. Meanwhile, the miners trigger a hazard in the tunnel that threatens their safety.

programs.title: Nazis on Drugs: Hitler and the Blitzkrieg
programs.desc: This is the story of World War II told through the astonishing filter of a widespread Nazi scheme to provide methamphetamine to German soldiers to make them invincible. It's an incredible, long-hidden history of a devious plan to find the chemical edge the Nazis knew they would need to conquer the world. And most shocking of all, this vast drug conspiracy is sourced straight from rare historical records secured by the Allies after the war.
